programs.title: The Extraordinary States of Procopius
programs.desc:
Marcin Prokop sets off overseas once again.According to the stereotype, the United States is a place of endless possibilities, where everyone can fulfill their dreams.In the new season of the program, the host will meet people who have found the recipe for success in life.In this way, he wants to find out whether there is a set of universal rules that guarantee happiness.He will visit, among others, the Skid Row district in Los Angeles, the NASA headquarters in Pasadena, the desert in Utah and a gold mine in Colorado.In each episode, viewers will discover new stories and places
The host visits the Dixie Dude Ranch, which was created for tourists.You can ride a horse here, feel like a resident of the prairie and experience the cowboy life.There are dozens of similar places in Texas.Marcin Prokop will try to find out whether they show the truth about the everyday life of the inhabitants of this part of America.There will also be a Polish accent.In the nearby town of Bandera there is a church built by Poles, where the parish priest is an emigrant from Silesia.Finally, a meeting with Ezekiel Mitchell, a professional bull rider, who will tell the host where his fascination with this dangerous sport comes from.

Gold diggers still inhabit Colorado.One of them is Kevin Singel, who in a conversation with Marcin Prokop will reveal whether the stories about overnight fortunes are true and how much the largest piece of precious metal he has found is worth.The host will also visit the mine of Jesse Patterson, who is considered a legend among the local gold prospectors.The man will try to teach Marcin a professional technique for rinsing stones and will talk about what he learned from the Poles he met many years ago.Finally, on the outskirts of Denver, Marcin will discover a real treasure - an extraordinary store resembling a museum of the 1980s.This visit will turn out to be a real journey back in time.

In this episode, Marcin Prokop sets off on a journey to Silicon Valley.But first, he will visit Sausalito, a city called the Venice of America.In this unique place, houses are built on the water, and residents are separated from the bustling San Francisco by a trip over the Golden Gate Bridge.However, in the heart of Silicon Valley there is Stanford University.This prestigious university counts among its graduates, among others, Elon Musk.This is where Han will tell the host about how to create your own company in the center of American technological thought.Marcin Prokop will also meet Jakub Pachocki.This will be a great opportunity to ask one of the creators of ChatGPT a few questions generated by this tool.

Opened in 1894, Huntsville Prison is an institution where over 580 people lost their lives.Executions of convicts were carried out using an electric chair, which can now be seen as a museum exhibit.David Stacks, a former prison guard, will talk about working there and the emotions that accompany meetings with the most dangerous criminals in America.Jimi Willet, former prison warden and execution supervisor, will reveal whether he ever managed to get used to death.Marcin will also ask him about the impact his job has on his family life.

programs.title: Secrets of the wrecks of the Baltic Sea
programs.desc: Franken is a German mechanically driven tanker sunk near Hel by Soviet aviation during World War II - on April 8, 1945.The wreck hides a story of great passion and, at the same time, great tragedy.Diving on it is demanding because you have to go below 40 meters, so partial decompression is necessary.In addition to the entire list of victims that Franken had when it sank in 1945, three divers should be added - a Czech and two Poles.The team places a symbolic expression of memory of the dead underwater, a monument that rests on the surface of one of the most dangerous wreck diving facilities.
